instruction: Organize the invoices by tax status. Create a folder called 'taxed' on the Desktop and move all invoices that have a non-zero tax amount into this folder.

metadata.explanation: Task requires examining all invoices to identify which have non-zero tax amounts. From the invoice PDFs: (1) Invoice TII-20220301-90 has $480.00 tax (6%), (2) Invoice GES-20220215-82 has $180.00 tax (6%), (3) Invoice #243729 has $0.00 tax (0%). The evaluator checks if the taxed folder contains the 2 invoices with non-zero tax (TII-20220301-90 and GES-20220215-82).
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Full score (1.0) if taxed folder contains exactly the 2 invoices with non-zero tax amounts (TII-20220301-90 and GES-20220215-82). Score 0.0 otherwise.
